question: What auspicious and wish-granting qualities are attributed to the deity?
premises: The deity is called the auspicious one among auspicious things.
The deity is described as the giver of the fruits of all desires.
inference: The deity embodies supreme auspiciousness and grants the fulfillment of all desires.
plain_english: He is the auspicious among auspicious things and the giver of the fruits of all desires.
